coordinate_convention.axes: Runtime: X east (-4096..4096), Y up, Z south (-4096..4096); runtime.z = -blender.y
coordinate_convention.row_direction: +Z (north to south: row 0 = minZ = -4096, row H-1 = maxZ = +4096)
coordinate_convention.col_direction: +X (west to east: col 0 = minX = -4096, col W-1 = maxX = +4096)
coordinate_convention.uv_mapping: u = (x - minX) / (maxX - minX), v = (z - minZ) / (maxZ - minZ) with texture.flipY = false

channels.R: Macro ground & grass albedo tint R (sRGB, aligned with art/palette.json)
channels.G: Macro ground & grass albedo tint G (sRGB, aligned with art/palette.json)
channels.B: Macro ground & grass albedo tint B (sRGB, aligned with art/palette.json)
channels.A: Combined large-scale 8-azimuth horizon sky-view AO x tree canopy shadow (0..255, 255 = full open sky)

channels.R: grass_density (0..1) — zero in water, on gravel paths, on steep rock >=32 deg, and on dry beach sand
channels.B: dry_mix (0..1) — blend between lush grass_green (#696F44) and sun-baked grass_dry (#635C30)
channels.A: canopy_shadow (0..1) — combined sky-view & tree canopy shadow multiplier (1 = open sky)
